name: W14 Morning Flow — Bodyweight Spine + Hip (All Days, Out-of-Heal-Week Variety)
description: 15 min bodyweight floor flow — universal W14 morning flow, used every training day (Mon push / Tue KB / Wed pull / Thu KB / Fri legs). Same three-part shape as W11/W12/W13 with rotated moves for variety. Three-part: spine primer → bodyweight work → deep stretch arc. Day-specific therapeutic add-on at the end (push = pec-minor protocol; pull = dead hang + scap pull; legs = cross-leg lateral lean + pigeon + supine twist; KB days skip — banded prep covers it).

exercises.notes: Slow, full ROM each direction. Spine wave wakes the segment-by-segment articulation.
Rotates back in (W11/W12 had it). Knees under hips, walk the hands forward, chest melts to the floor. Deep shoulder + lat opener.

Standing, knees soft, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — the wrist dials a stretch up the back chain. Stays in the primer from W13.

sets.name: Work Block — Bodyweight Activation (~5 min)

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Lunge → hand to floor → reach the rear-side arm to ceiling. Full-body opener — hip flexor + thoracic + lat all in one shape.
Plank with alternating shoulder taps. Anti-rotation — hips stay square, no swinging.
45s alternating. From down-dog, draw one knee toward the forehead, hold a beat, switch. Core + hip + shoulder integration.
45s slow. Durable hip opener under plank load.
30s each side. The windmill on the floor — lateral-hinge cue translation.

sets.notes: World's greatest stretch + shoulder taps rotate in for variety. Anti-rotation gets a different shape than W13's bird-dog.

sets.name: Yoga Flow — Deep Stretch Arc (~7 min)

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Stays every week — signature spine move.
30s each direction. Quadruped hip abduction — slow, full ROM.
30s each side. Hip flexor + adductor + back-leg quad. Drop to elbows if accessible. Stays — durable hip opener.
Bodyweight, slow. Stays every week — mirrors the Tuesday loaded cossack.
30s each side. Static pigeon rotates back in this week — long hold on the hip release.
Rotates in for W14 — supine hip opener on the back. Pull knees toward the armpits, grip the outsides of the feet, gently rock.

sets.notes: Continuous arc — flow between shapes, breathe deeply. Anchors stay (scorpion, cossack, lizard); pigeon comes back static, happy baby joins for variety.

sets.name: 📍 Day-Specific Add-On — Pick by Today's Training (~3-5 min)

exercises.notes: **📍 PUSH DAYS — KEY PROTOCOL MOVE.** 30s each at LOW / MID / HIGH elbow positions. Arm bent 90°, forearm on the door frame, step through and rotate the torso AWAY. Desk work continuously re-tightens pec minor — daily.
**📍 PUSH DAYS** — active side of the pec-minor fix. Lower trap + rotator cuff.
**📍 PUSH DAYS** — serratus activation, helps unstick a tight pec minor.
**📍 PUSH DAYS (optional)** — slow rotator cuff work. Add if the shoulder feels off.
**📍 PUSH DAYS (optional)** — pins the shoulder blades in the corrected position.
**📍 PULL DAYS** — 25s. Decompress the shoulders, warm the grip.
**📍 PULL DAYS** — scapulae retracting only, no elbow bend. Crisp scap engagement before loaded pulls.
**📍 LEGS DAYS** — 30s each side. Scissor one foot over the other, reach the same-side arm overhead, lean away from the back leg — QL/psoas release. Also in the legs-workout warmup.
**📍 LEGS DAYS — W8 QL-SPASM PROTOCOL.** 90s each side. Long hold lets the QL/psoas release. Non-negotiable on legs day.
**📍 LEGS DAYS** — 60s each side. Gentle twist for the QL. Lacrosse-ball QL roll above the iliac crest beforehand if available.

sets.notes: **Pick today's day-specific protocol — push / pull / legs.** ~3-5 min total. KB days (Tue/Thu) skip this block — the in-workout banded prep covers the equivalent.

tips: Same shape as W11/W12/W13, rotated moves. Morning flows stay low-fatigue, variety keeps them fresh.
**15 min main flow + 3-5 min day-specific add-on** — universal across W14 (Mon push / Tue KB / Wed pull / Thu KB / Fri legs).
**Scorpion + cossack BW + lizard pose stay every week** — durable anchors.
**Puppy pose, world's greatest stretch, shoulder taps, happy baby rotate in for W14** variety.
**Day-specific add-on at the end** — push days do the pec-minor protocol, pull days do dead hang + scap pull, legs days do cross-leg lean + 90s pigeon + supine twist. KB days skip the add-on.
If short on time: scorpion + lizard + cossack BW + pigeon, plus today's day-specific add-on.
formPhilosophy: Same as W11/W12/W13 — variety means different shapes hitting the same patterns. Scorpion-family spine work + hip openers + adductor stretches. Morning flows stay structured around the in-workout banded prep's logic on KB days, and the day-specific protocols on PPL days.
